messages:
ria_sales: Heads up: BlueHarbor wants a 72-hour POC next month. They want ephemeral hosted keys issued via OIDC broker, auditable rotation proof, and a fast revoke channel (Slack DM to Security team + API). Can we support and what's the handoff?

omar_se: Yes. Pattern I recommend: issue an OIDC-backed short-lived key (ttl=72h) minted by our token broker. This avoids long-lived plaintext tokens.

omar_se: For the sales doc, simple create example (service account):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SALES_SVC" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"name":"blueharbor-poc-oidc","scopes":["generate.text","embeddings.read"],"ttl_hours":72,"mint_method":"oidc_broker"}' | jq .
```

omar_se: Broker flow: mobile/demo client gets an app session -> calls your backend -> backend exchanges a short-lived broker token for the hosted key. No tokens on-device.

todd_infra: Infra note: we can enable audit-forwarding + signed exports. For rotation proof we emit events: key.created, key.minted (broker), key.rotated, key.revoked. Each event includes actor, ip, and ISO timestamp.

anya_compliance: Compliance asks for export formats: we can provide JSON + a compact CSV summary with columns: event_type, key_id, actor_email, timestamp, request_id. We can HMAC-sign the export for legal requests.

ria_sales: BlueHarbor also wants an emergency revoke option: DM to #security-ops with ticket id. Can Security accept that?

security-bot: [policy] emergency_revoke_via_slack: allowed if DM comes from verified SSO user and includes ticket id. Security will confirm via SSO and then call revoke; an audit event + signed export will be produced.

omar_se: Revocation snippet for docs (API):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/kr_601234/revoke \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SALES_SVC"
```
Console: Keys -> kr_601234 -> Revoke. Revoke generates key.revoked event.

todd_infra: Audit export example (JSON):
GET /v1/audit/keys?key_id=kr_601234&from=2167880000&to=2167966399 -> returns events array. We can also call /v1/audit/exports?key_id=kr_601234&format=csv to get signed CSV.

anya_compliance: Add to playbook: require ticket justification in the sales ticket, 2FA on the sales account, and retention spec (default 90d for POCs; request 365d for enterprise). Also document the HMAC signature verification steps for the customer.

ria_sales: Who owns rotation during demos (weekend shows)? I can handle weekdays but need automated flow for off-hours.

omar_se: We have two options: 1) schedule automated rotation in Console with webhook alert 3h prior, or 2) use broker on-demand issuance so demo clients always request fresh tokens from your backend. For BlueHarbor Id enable scheduled rotation at 48h and webhook alerts to your SRE channel.

security-bot: [automated] key_request_logged id=kr_601234 owner=ria_sales ttl_hours=72 scope=generate.text,embeddings.read mint_method=oidc_broker status=pending-infra

todd_infra: Approving 9will provision broker-backed key and enable audit-forwarding toggle. Ill attach sample signed export and curl snippets to the ticket.

ria_sales: Perfect. Please add the emergency Slack-DM revoke steps into the runbook and cc me. Leaving open until export and ticket are attached. :thumbsup:
